engine_requirements: No new adapter needed now. Keep html monitor on https://www.ffem.fr/en/calls-for-projects/list. When a call opens, the list will show call cards. A future structured adapter would need: GET the list page (plain HTTP, no cookies), parse each card for title, status (Ongoing / Opening soon / Closed call), deadline text, and detail URL; then GET each detail page for the deadline. Status values are the English labels on the list. Do this only once a real call card is present in live HTML, since no card markup exists to test against right now.
note: Re-run this probe when the FAQ resumption date passes (2027). Or when news announces a new call.
